rv.q: The orchestra under the direction of Linda Madonia fills the theater with the toe tapping score.
The cast and creative team go all out to send the audience off on a high note, and it was enough to sell me again on the fun of this show, if not the heart of its central relationship.
LITTLE SHOP OF HORRORS is a fun visit to Skid Row!
This exciting and expertly crafted production arrives just in time for Halloween and slays, like most other shows by Music Theater Works.
One major factor that made this particular version stand out was the phenomenally talented cast.
What a fun show produced with the quality you expect from Music Theater Works.

cn.t: Critics praise this production of "Little Shop of Horrors" as a fun, entertaining revival that delivers laughs and creepy thrills, with strong performances bringing fresh energy to the beloved musical's darkly humorous tale.
